declarations.name: deriv
declarations.signature_excerpt:
def deriv (f : 𝕜 → F) (x : 𝕜) :=

declarations.name: HasDerivAt.comp
declarations.signature_excerpt:
theorem HasDerivAt.comp (hh₂ : HasDerivAt h₂ h₂' (h x)) (hh : HasDerivAt h h' x) :
    HasDerivAt (h₂ ∘ h) (h₂' * h') x :=
  HasDerivAtFilter.comp hh₂ hh <| hh.continuousAt.tendsto.prodMap <| tendsto_pure_pure _ _

declarations.name: deriv_comp
declarations.signature_excerpt:
theorem deriv_comp (hh₂ : DifferentiableAt 𝕜' h₂ (h x)) (hh : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 h x) :
    deriv (h₂ ∘ h) x = deriv h₂ (h x) * deriv h x :=
  (hh₂.hasDerivAt.comp x hh.hasDerivAt).deriv

declarations.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
declarations.signature_excerpt:
structure Measure (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] extends OuterMeasure α where
  m_iUnion ⦃f : ℕ → Set α⦄ : (∀ i, MeasurableSet (f i)) → Pairwise (Disjoint on f) →
    toOuterMeasure (⋃ i, f i) = ∑' i, toOuterMeasure (f i)

declarations.name: Measurable
declarations.signature_excerpt:
def Measurable [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] (f : α → β) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃t : Set β⦄, MeasurableSet t → MeasurableSet (f ⁻¹' t)
